question: Yes or no?

input.rule: rate = max rate x local contrast, where local contrast is the standard deviation of picture brightness over the eye columns that feed the cell, weighted by synapse count and divided by 0.5

who_did_what.fly: where each input cell looks, how its firing spreads and competes between the two sides, which side the steering neuron fired on, and so the choice
who_did_what.rig: the question, the options, drawing them as pictures, the early vision (turning picture contrast into firing of the input cells), the rule that reads a turn as a choice

attribution: Connectome: MaleCNS v1.0, FlyEM Project Team at HHMI Janelia, Cambridge Connectomics Group and Google Research, CC BY 4.0 (Berg et al., Cell 2026). Neuron model: Shiu et al., Nature 2024.
repeatability: Measured on 2026-11-12 with python -m dro.repeat: yes won 20 of 20 runs, 66.3 steering spikes against 13.1 on average. yes is also the picture with more contrast (34.5 Hz of input against 23.9 Hz).
